Subject: Re: Polaris bank details + onboarding packet (PO 41127)

Hi Maya — thanks for sending these over and for the quick turnaround. I’ve looped in Ben from Finance and Laura on Procurement to finalize mapping. A few quick items from our side: 

1) Could you confirm the account holder legal name exactly as it should appear on Redwood’s payment record? We have “Polaris Biosystems, Inc.” on file but want to match your bank form.
2) For remittance, we typically post the PO number in the invoice description so AP auto-links it to payments. Can Polaris confirm that invoices will include “PO 41127” in the invoice header?
3) We’ll kick off the verification (micro-deposit) now. Expect a pair of small deposits from Redwood Finance; please confirm the amounts when they hit.

Ben/Laura — if you can confirm we have everything needed to mark the vendor active and queue the first payment (end of next week cadence), that would be great.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Vendor Ops | Procurement
Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com

Hi all,

I reviewed the bank form and W-9. That account name lines up with our KYC: "Polaris Biosystems, Inc.". Two operational notes from Finance: 

- Our AP system requires the invoice filename to include the PO number (example: invoice_PO-41127_202809.pdf) to auto-attach. Please ask Polaris to adopt that naming convention where possible.
- Remittance instructions: Redwood sends remittance info back to the invoice 'Bill To' contact by default. If Polaris wants remits copied to ap@polarisbio.com, I’ve added that address to the vendor record.

I’ve started the micro-deposit verification (should appear today). Once Maya confirms the deposit amounts, I will flip the vendor to Active and route the first payment per terms (Net 30, next payment run 2028-09-29).

Attachments: none

Thanks — Ben

Appreciate the quick help getting setup. Looking forward to first run on 2028-09-29.
